item.title: A Montreal bakery is in the OQLF's crosshairs for its English TikToks
item.description: A letter from Quebec's language watchdog to the Villeray bakery Lahmajoune did not threaten a fine, but asked that the situation be corrected “as soon as possible.”

item.title: Montreal weather: Finally, a TV show where potholes are the real villain
item.description: This weekend bridges February and March, meaning pothole season — which got an early and fierce start — is truly underway.

item.title: The Right Chemistry: There are lots of longevity regimens. One stands out for me
item.description: Amid an explosion of aging research, there are plenty of “biohackers” out there jumping the gun without waiting for proof of efficacy.

item.title: Todd: U.S. Olympic men's team leaves icy stain on hockey that won't go away
item.description: By being not-so-innocent props in an insult to the women's team and a Trump propaganda carnival, the players disrespected fans across Canada.

item.title: Lakeshore General Hospital postpones some elective surgeries after flooding
item.description: The incident seems to have been caused by malfunctioning heating coils and was quickly brought under control, spokesperson says.

item.title: New transitional housing centre in Montreal North will focus on mental health
item.description: Residents will be surrounded by health-care and social workers who will help them access the resources before moving to permanent housing.

item.title: New federal language watchdog will bolster Canadian bilingualism, Carney says
item.description: In House of Commons testimony, Kelly Burke wouldn’t say whether she would support Quebec anglophones’ legal challenge to the CAQ's plan to abolish English school boards.

item.title: Why is playing with a lead playing with fire for the Canadiens?
item.description: "We've just got to learn from all those things," assistant coach Stéphane Robidas says of Habs' blown advantage in OT loss to Islanders.

item.title: McGill unveils task force to chart future of varsity sports following recent team cuts
item.description: University officials say it will be looking forward and not revisiting the cuts to sports teams announced last fall.

item.title: Man on trial for death of 15-year-old girl in St-Léonard insists he was the only gunman
item.description: Salim Touaibi testifies it was not his intention to kill or harm someone. "It was stupid. It was disgusting."
